name: Wizard Extraordinaire (Human Universalist 7)
source: The War of the Goblin King
book: The War of the Goblin King

facets.bk: The War of the Goblin King

body:
Wizard Extraordinaire

CR 6

XP 2,400
Male human universalist 7
N Medium humanoid (human)
Init +2; Senses Perception +6 (+8 while his familiar is within arm’s reach)

DEFENSE

AC 12, touch 12, flat-footed 10 (+2 Dex)
hp 34 (7d6+7)
Fort +4, Ref +5, Will +7

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee masterwork quarterstaff +3 (1d6-1)
Special Attacks hand of the apprentice (5/day)
Wizard Spells Prepared (CL 7th; concentration +12)

4th—arcane eye, dimension door
3rd—arcane sight, fireball (DC 18), fly
2nd—arcane lock, invisibility, magic mouth, scorching ray
1st—mage armor (2), magic missile (3), unseen servant
0—detect magic, mending, prestidigitation, read magic

STATISTICS

Str 8, Dex 14, Con 12, Int 20, Wis 8, Cha 14
Base Atk +3; CMB +2; CMD 15
Feats Brew Potion, Combat Casting, Craft Wand, Craft Wondrous Item, Iron Will, Magical Aptitude, Scribe Scroll
Skills Bluff +9, Disguise +9, Knowledge (arcana) +15, Knowledge (dungeoneering) +15, Knowledge (nature) +15, Knowledge (planes) +15, Linguistics +15, Perception +6 (+8 while his familiar is within arm’s reach), Spellcraft +17
Languages Abyssal, Aquan, Auran, Celestial, Common, Draconic, Elven, Ignan, Infernal, Sylvan, Terran, Undercommon
SQ arcane bond (owl familiar), cantrips
NPC Gear cloak of resistance +1, disguise kit, fake beard, headband of vast intelligence +2 (perception), masterwork quarterstaff
